answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before attesting others, with slashing when an attestation proves false. Honest work then builds a shared atlas of trust: each verified attestation adds a durable link, while fake identities start with none and must pay the full stake per persona. A newcomer cannot buy a haven of fake peers, because stake is scarce and slashing is slow to recover - like a glacier, trust accumulates gradually and melts fast when abused, so each fake identity carries a real compounding cost.
